nodes.name: Query Motion

parameters.text:
=Break this debate motion into its argument skeleton. Describe structure only. Never argue a side.

The abstract_core field is what matters. ONE sentence, 25-40 words: what is at stake, both competing values, and what is given up in exchange.

HARD RULE: abstract_core must contain NO word that reveals the subject matter. Name every party structurally instead: "the party with less power", "the individual", "the institution", "the collective", "a practice", "an entitlement". Forbidden are all subject nouns, including but not limited to: dead, deceased, departed, mourning, women, gender, student, school, credential, worker, wage, patient, passenger, aircraft, food, money, vote, child, love, youth, internet, platform, technology.

TEST BEFORE YOU ANSWER: your abstract_core must plausibly fit at least three motions from completely unrelated fields. If a reader could name the topic from it, it has failed. Rewrite it.

Example of a FAILED core (topic visible): "Whether society should dismantle the norm protecting the reputation of the deceased, trading respect for the departed against the right to unvarnished truth."
The same core, FIXED: "Whether an openly held practice should be condemned because a minority abuse it, or judged by the principle it serves, when extending any entitlement to everyone makes some misuse inevitable."

Two more correct examples:
Motion: This house would ban payday lending -> "Whether the collective should prohibit an agreement the weaker party enters willingly, to prevent extraction from them, at the cost of removing the only option they had left."
Motion: This house believes talent matters more than effort -> "Whether an outcome is better explained by an endowment the individual did not choose or by a contribution they did, trading recognition of merit against the coherence of holding anyone responsible."

Other fields, all short and also topic-stripped: value_clash (the two competing values, one clause). burdens (one clause per side). stakeholders (structural, not by sector). core_mechanism (one sentence, the causal chain in dispute).

Output ONE JSON object and nothing else. No markdown fences, no commentary. Every value must be a plain string. Exact shape:
{"abstract_core":"...","value_clash":"...","burdens":"...","stakeholders":"...","core_mechanism":"..."}

Motion: {{ $json.motion }}

/no_think

assignments.name: topical_results
assignments.value: ={{ $('Topical Search').all().map((i, n) => ({ rank: n + 1, motion: i.json.document.metadata.motion, score: Number(i.json.score.toFixed(3)), source: i.json.document.metadata.source })) }}

assignments.name: structural_results
assignments.value: ={{ $('Structural Search').all().map((i, n) => ({ rank: n + 1, motion: i.json.document.metadata.motion, score: Number(i.json.score.toFixed(3)), source: i.json.document.metadata.source, why: i.json.document.pageContent })) }}
